name: Codebase Quality
description: Automated code review for codebase using multiple specialized agents.
longDescription:
Ships **7 agents** and **1 command**.

- **Agents** (7): `claude-md-resolver` (Locate all relevant CLAUDE.md files for a given audit scope and provide their paths (no contents)), `compliance-auditor` (Check for unambiguous violations of applicable CLAUDE.md rules (must quote exact rule + exact violating lines)), `deterministic-bug-scan` (Find deterministic correctness failures (merge conflict markers, malformed JSON, dependency-free syntax/compile errors when requested)), `logic-quality-auditor` (Flag high-confidence logic quality issues (empty catch blocks, unreachable code, excessive complexity, obvious bugs)), `repo-profiler` (Profile repository structure, languages, and likely build/test entrypoints; propose safe smoke commands), `secret-auditor` (High-signal scan for committed secrets), `tracked-env-detector` (List suspicious tracked files by name (e.g., .env, *.pem) WITHOUT reading contents; used as input to secret-auditor)
- **Commands** (1): `codebase-quality` (High-signal quality check of the current codebase (not a PR))

Installs with `claude plugin install codebase-quality@claude-community` from `baranbingol1/claude-codebase-quality`.
